courses.course_title: Home Furnishing Management and Housing Design
courses.title_as_written: Home Furnishing Management and Housing Design
courses.synopsis: Relationship between life styles and housing. Identifying house requirements and limitations. Flow of goods and activities in buildings. Form and functions in housing. Kitchen planning. Functions, selections and use of furnishings. Practical interior furnishing techniques. Fibres and structure in relation to comfort, hygiene, durability and beauty. Decoration, refurbishing and restoration of furniture and soft furnishing.
